message.content:
This is a valve keeper (collet) for a gasoline engine valve train. It is a part of a spark-ignition engine, so it falls under heading 8409, which covers parts suitable for use solely or principally with engines of heading 8407 or 8408. Within that heading, 8409.91 covers parts for spark-ignition engines. The 8409.91.50 subheading covers parts for engines other than aircraft and is split into 8409.91.10 (aircraft) and 8409.91.50 (other). The 8409.91.50 line is further divided as follows: 8409.91.5030 for cylinder liners, 8409.91.5040 for carburetors, and so on.

The relevant US subheadings under 8409.91 are:
- 8409.91.10: for aircraft engines
- 8409.91.20: other, for use in vehicles of chapter 87 (8409.91.2000 doesn't exist as such)
- 8409.91.50: other

I recall the current structure as 8409.91.1000 (for aircraft), 8409.91.2000 (cylinder liners/sleeves?), 8409.91.3000 (carburetors?), 8409.91.5000, 8409.91.9000 (other, e.g., 8409.91.9990 other). Past CBP rulings on valve spring retainer locks have used 8409.91.9990. Since I recall that ruling outcome, I'll go with 8409.91.9990.
